item.title: 2025 WinterFest Columbus Food Vendor Application is NOW OPEN!
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

The food vendor application for WinterFest Columbus is NOW OPEN!

WinterFest Columbus, presented by Columbus Recreation and Parks Department, is an annual celebration of the winter season in Columbus. This free event features seasonal craft beer and cocktails, live music, some of Columbus' best food trucks, and lots of outdoor winter fun!

The festival will occur Saturday, December 6, 2025, in downtown Columbus, Ohio. WinterFest Columbus is actively seeking food trucks that will provide patrons with a variety of unique food options to enjoy while attending this signature event. To learn more and apply for a food vending space, please review the food vendor information and submit and application.

Additional information can be found by clicking the button below. All food vendors wishing to participate must first complete this application. Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance. First consideration will be given to applications submitted by Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, priority will be given to applications submitted by Monday, October 6, 2025.

item.title: 2025 Jazz & Rib Fest Food Vendor Application is Open!
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

The food vendor application for the 2025 Jazz & Rib Fest is now open!

Jazz & Rib Fest is now accepting applications for the 2025 festival! We’re looking for BBQ and festival food vendors to bring unique and delicious flavors to thousands of hungry guests. This is your chance to serve mouthwatering eats while fans enjoy three days of nonstop live jazz along the Scioto Mile!

Jazz & Rib Fest, presented by Columbus Recreation and Parks, will occur July 18, 19 and 20, 2025, in downtown Columbus, Ohio. This FREE festival draws over 200,000 attendees, offering both jazz and rib connoisseurs the finest in music and barbecue.

Please note, you are receiving this message because you have either applied to be a part of the event previously or signed up to receive updates from Jazz & Rib Fest. You may unsubscribe from this list at any time.

Food Vendor Application

item.title: Jazz & Rib Fest - Save the Date
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Jazz & Rib Fest - Save the Date

Jazz & Rib Fest, presented by the Columbus Recreation and Parks Department, is a highly anticipated summertime tradition offering both jazz and rib connoisseurs the finest in music and barbecue. The 2025 Jazz & Rib Fest will take place on July 18-20, in downtown Columbus, Ohio.

A new food vendor application is coming in 2025! Jazz & Rib Fest will be launching a brand new application for BBQ vendors and festival food (non-BBQ) vendors. This process will feature streamlined coordination with event management, and built-in communication tools. Another message will be sent when the application is ready. Be on the lookout for the application announcement in the coming weeks.

item.description:

The food vendor application for WinterFest Columbus is NOW OPEN!

WinterFest Columbus, presented by Columbus Recreation and Parks Department, is an annual celebration of the winter season in downtown Columbus. This free event features local seasonal craft beer and cocktails, live music, some of Columbus’ best food trucks, and lots of outdoor winter fun!

Event Details

Date: Dec. 7, 2024
Time: 11 a.m. – 4 p.m.
Location: Bicentennial Park, 233 Civic Center Dr., Columbus, OH 43215

Vendor Information

To apply for a food vending space, please complete the application at the link below. All food vendors wishing to participate must first complete this application. Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance.

First consideration will be given to applications submitted by 11:59 p.m. EST on Sunday, Sept. 15, 2024. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and notification of acceptance or nonacceptance will be sent by email to all applicants.
